title: Rutin Attenuates Gentamycin-induced Hair Cell Injury in the Zebrafish Lateral Line via Suppressing STAT1.
authors: Yang, Huiming; Zong, Tao; Liu, Jing; Wang, Dengxu; Gong, Ke; Yin, Haiyan; Zhang, Weiwei; Xu, Tong; Yang, Rong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芦丁对庆大霉素诱导斑马鱼毛细胞损伤的保护作用，涉及STAT1蛋白的分子对接，但核心是药物保护机制而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Aminoglycoside antibiotics, including gentamicin (GM), induce delayed ototoxic effects such as hearing loss after prolonged use, which results from the death of hair cells. However, the mechanisms underlying the ototoxicity of aminoglycosides warrant further investigation, and there are currently no effective drugs in the clinical setting. Herein, the therapeutic effect of the flavonoid compound rutin against the ototoxic effects of GM in zebrafish hair cells was investigated. Animals incubated with rutin (100-400 micromol/L) were protected against the pernicious effects of GM (200 micromol/L). We found that rutin improves hearing behavior in zebrafish, and rutin was effective in reducing the number of Tunel-positive cells in the neuromasts of the zebrafish lateral line and promoting cell proliferation after exposure to GM. Subsequently, rutin exerted a protective effect against GM-induced cell death in HEI-OC1 cells and could limit the production of cytosolic reactive oxygen species (ROS) and diminish the percentage of apoptotic cells. Additionally, the results of the proteomic analysis revealed that rutin could effectively inhibit the expression of necroptosis and apoptosis related genes. Meanwhile, molecular docking analysis revealed a high linking activity between the molecular docking of rutin and STAT1 proteins. The protection of zebrafish hair cells or HEI-OC1 cells from GM-induced ototoxicity by rutin was attenuated by the introduction of STAT1 activator. Finally, we demonstrated that rutin significantly improves the bacteriostatic effect of GM by in vitro experiments, emphasising its clinical application value. In summary, these results collectively unravel a novel therapeutic role for rutin as an otoprotective drug against the adverse effects of GM.
abstract_zh: 氨基糖苷类抗生素，包括庆大霉素（GM），在长期使用后会诱导延迟性耳毒性效应，如听力损失，这源于毛细胞的死亡。然而，氨基糖苷类耳毒性的潜在机制仍需进一步研究，且目前临床上尚无有效药物。本研究探讨了黄酮类化合物芦丁对斑马鱼毛细胞中GM耳毒性效应的治疗作用。用芦丁（100-400微摩尔/升）孵育的动物免受GM（200微摩尔/升）的有害影响。我们发现芦丁改善了斑马鱼的听觉行为，并在GM暴露后有效减少了斑马鱼侧线神经丘中Tunel阳性细胞的数量，同时促进了细胞增殖。随后，芦丁对GM诱导的HEI-OC1细胞死亡表现出保护作用，并能限制胞质活性氧（ROS）的产生，降低凋亡细胞的比例。此外，蛋白质组学分析结果显示，芦丁能有效抑制坏死性凋亡和凋亡相关基因的表达。同时，分子对接分析揭示了芦丁与STAT1蛋白之间具有高结合活性。通过引入STAT1激活剂，芦丁对斑马鱼毛细胞或HEI-OC1细胞免受GM诱导耳毒性的保护作用被减弱。最后，我们通过体外实验证明，芦丁显著提高了GM的抑菌效果，强调了其临床应用价值。总之，这些结果共同揭示了芦丁作为一种耳保护药物对抗GM不良效应的新型治疗作用。
